company_info.company_description: " Evo Solar knows that not all solar and solar installations are the same. That’s why we don’t offer lots of products or use third-party contractors for installation.Instead, we use industry-leading quality technology and in-house certified electricians for every installation. Evo Solar offers home energy solutions that will not just save you money, they will pay for themselves over and over again.Products guaranteed for 25-40 years by the manufacturer and backed by our 25 year workmanship warranty. Our products are safe, reliable, modular and out-perform all the competition. Installed by us for you. Talk to us about a tailored energy solution for your home today."

reviews.review_description: Had previously installed solar panels & on this occasion the install was a solar battery. Very happy with install process. Quick & smooth, now just waiting for first power bill to check out the savings. Happy to recommend.

Evo Solar quoted for 2 systems, we went for the dearest system 34 solar panels & the Tesla powerwall 3 to go with the 20 panels we had already installed. Cameron explained the difference between the 2 systems. Cameron came & inspected the house on the 4th of October & the installation was two weeks later on the 18th of October. The installation took two days. Was going to be a thursday & friday, but because of bad weather thursday was cancelled & they came back on the sunday to finish off the installation. Inspector checked & ok'd the installation the next friday. Grid connection is not approved yet as communication between tesla & powercor regarding "Emergency Backstop process" is still ongoing. When they receive confirmation from tesla & powercor they will complete the grid registration. Customer service great I have been kept up to date with the whole process by email & use of charger is easy with the Tesla  App.

The sales process was quick and easy. Cam explained everything really well and provided all options.The install was really good. Communication was amazing and the guys on site were polite and left my garage clean and tidy.The grid connection was done in the same week and was straightforward.After the battery was turned on any questions were answered .Overall 5 stars

Travis and his co-worker arrived a little earlier than scheduled and got to work straight away. Five hours later my Tesla Powerwall-3 and Gateway were installed and working. The installation is neat and tidy and the area thoroughly cleaned up. I had a few concerns about the location of the Powerwall  These were quickly dispelled by Travis who adapted the location to my satisfaction. In all I am extremely satisfied with the service proved by EVO including the site visit by Cam, quotation and the work completed by his crew. Now we look forward to our system working as planned.

Evo solar team did a great job they came and removed my old system and installed the new system .All done and dusted in the day ,they organised the grid connection and were great people to deal with. The sales team were great to communicate with, all good all round.

Thank you EVO SOLAR for adding a second Storage Battery within 2 weeks of phoning you.The team arrived early at the time they quoted. They are always courteous and clean up after finishing the job.My dog was excited to see them again which they reciprocated with lots of pats.Well done Cam and Team.

Fabulous service, everything done professionally and is working great, I didn't lift a finger they even cleaned up, spotless.             A company with all 5 star reviews including mine.  Highly recommend!.

Evo Solar was a great company to deal with. Following a site visit, the quote was detailed, there were no hidden charges and the installation went well. Though Evo Solar wasn't the cheapest quote, meeting with Cam at the site visit and in subsequent discussions gave us a lot of confidence in his knowledge and advice. Three weeks after installation, we are really happy with our solar system (panels and Powerwall battery). We have not drawn power from the grid once since then.

Professional and friendly advice from the beginning to the end. Quoting process was easy and there was no pressure to commit.Installers were very capable and kept me informed throughout the installation. They were punctual and careful of the property throughout the installation.After installation they assisted to setup the app on my smartphone and explained how to use the app.All done it was a great experience due to the professionalism of the workers. Support from office staff was first rate.

The installation in Ballarat yesterday went absolutely according to plan.  Team arrived at 7am, assessed work site and commenced shortly afterwards.  All staff knew their tasks and work effectively to complete the job by mid afternoon.  Currently awaiting inspection, but have been shown the on-line portal for monitoring the system.Job site left clean and tidy.

Very happy with our installation with no issues to date. The team worked well together and were reliable, tidy & professional at all times.  Thanks to all the team & especially to Travers who ensured all tasks were dealt with in a friendly efficient manner. Quoting & administration were conducted promptly & responded to very quickly.

I learnt a lot through the quoting process.  The installation was very smooth and the guys that did the install were great.  They connected it to the grid but I'm currently still waiting for the inspector to come and give the final signoff and turn the system on.

During the quoting process, Cam is able to give a concise detail and provide good recommendations that fit my requirements. He was also not pushy and allowed me time to think through the options. Then, the installation has been smooth and they also helped with organising the grid connection after install. Cam is also great in answering questions during and after installation.

Evo Solar was great from start to finish. Cameron's on-site pre-quote inspection gave advice about using or roof space to achieve greater performance and efficiency and options for siting the battery.Jos and his team carried out an extremely efficient installation process. They were on time, kept us informed about what they were doing and left our property in a very tide state, even mopping floors.Evo provided advice on completing necessary documentation for the grid connection and followed up to ensure we understood how to use the system.Highly recommend.

Amazingly professional and helpful service. Cam gave lots of advice and guidance (and a few re-quotes) before we had even agreed to sign with his company. He was friendly and professional and responded quickly to enquiries. The solar panels were installed soon after signing and the installation and removal of old panels was super quick. The tradies left the job site perfectly clean. Evo Solar also took care of all the paperwork for rebates after explaining them all carefully to us. Cam's communication throughout was excellent and he stayed in contact until the app readings were all working properly and we were satisfied. Very happy that we went with Evo Solar as the starting process was a little overwhelming with not knowing who to go with or who you could trust. Thanks Cam and team. Could not recommend enough.

Sales and quoting was done through phone and email - was OK, but used Google Maps to suss out roof positioning, and didn't realise there were some small issues that were only picked up at install.Install was great, wet day and the team were brilliant, got it all done in unfavourable conditions.Still going through connection process, just had electrical inspector sign-off with no issues.
From initial response with tender quotes, Cam was very helpful and spared the time to go into detail re; our queries. Installation was on time, a good team involved and very courteous.

The products installed by EVO Solar were a Tesla Powerwall 2 battery and Tesla Wall Connector.Cam, at EVO Solar, was very prompt at replying to my sales inquiry and provided a very competitive quote.His office staff helped guide me through the Solar Vic battery Loan process and were always available to answer questions. In their absence, Cam always returned my calls.Jos, the installer was excellent at communication and updates in the lead up to the installation day. He and Joel were punctual, friendly and their workmanship was of an extremely high standard.Jos went through the commissioning process of both items and was only too happy to answer any questions.
Great and knowledgeable business to deal with start to finish.

Cam and the team at Evo Solar are awesome. Cam was patient and detailed when going through the quote process. Jos, Trav and the team on site were friendly, helpful, neat and just the kind of crew you want to have around a major install. Everything went as planned with no surprises, all questions were answered and they were patient when showing us how everything works.Even the office staff, Toni and Rosalind are great, friendly and very efficient.Working with trades people you can trust is very satisfying and stress free. Thanks guys!
Job was completed by professionals, There was no mess, and everything was explained clearly when completed!
Cameron and his office staff and installers did a great job. I would recomend them to anyone wanting to install solar panels

Everything was explained when I requested a quote. The quote was not the cheapest but the quality of materials that they use convinced me that was the way to go.I found the team that do the installation were professional, polite, tidy and friendly. They turned up on time and seemed to get on with the job. I was kept in the loop as to what was going on and they were happy to answer any questions I had.The installation was only finished yesterday, so I still have to wait for the inspection to complete it all.Apart from the solar system they also installed a split system, hot water pump, and induction stove in two days.

Cam from Evo Solar was very helpful to understand the different systems, products and rebates available.Installers were polite, did a quality job and left the site very tidy.Excellent communication throughout the whole process.
Evo Solar was very good to deal with. Installation was carried out in an efficient manner. The site was left tidy and no tiles broken!

Couldn’t be happier with the process of getting solar from Evo Solar.From initial contact through to a flawless installation, the entire process was no pressure, educational and professional.Cam helped us understand our options in plain English, explained the impact of various changes, and was happy to build multiple quotes so we could find a system that suited us. There was no sales pressure, and lots of patience.The tradespeople that conducted the install were punctual, friendly & professional, and left the house / roof cleaner than when they arrived! Installation is very neat and tidy.Will be going back to Evo Solar when the time comes for an EV charger.

Cam, Toni & the team were incredible to deal with. Every call, question or request was met without hesitation and everyone was great.So many options were given with great detail, for someone who doesn’t know much about solar they made it all so simple. Didn’t push paying for more than what we could afford and gave us everything we needed!Installers were clean, efficient and polite! Couldn’t recommend more for solar.

Cam from Evo Solar provided 3 different scenarios for our solar install, including pros and cons for each option. He did a site visit and explained the options very clearly- we are not able to afford a battery just yet, but wanted a robust solar system that could accomodate battery storage and EV car charging in the future.We opted for a 12.9 KW system and a 10KW Gen24 Fronius inverter with Trina 400W panels. The inverter was not available so we waited 8 weeks for it to be released. In that time, Trina released 440W panels, and Cam upgraded to those at no extra cost. This bumped our system up to 13.2KW.The install was very neat- the installers were all Evo Solar employees (not contractors). The rails were installed without requiring any extra access holes in the roof. Install was interrupted by some severe weather, but the team returned on the weekend after to complete the job.Evo Solar took care of liaising with my power company and wholesaler.

The whole process of working with Evo Solar was excellent from pre-sales, through installation to after-sales service.Within minutes of my initial conversation with Cam, I had a series of options all fully quoted, diagrammed and with contracts ready to electronically sign.The installation went perfectly smoothly. The installers were efficient and friendly and informed us of what was happening throughout the process.The customer service from EVO is come of the best I have had the pleasure of experiencing. Communications were timely and friendly. All aspects of the installation were taken care of, not just the installation, but ensuring that both the power grid and my retail provider were informed and establishing my service promptly. The after-sales service has also been excellent with follow-up questions being handled brilliantly.Cam is clearly running an incredible business at EVO and everyone clearly understands their role and the value they add to the client. Cannot recommend enough.

The "salesperson" for EVO Solar is Cam a local licenced electrician servicing Geelong and Surf Coast.  He was not only talks the talk but walks the walk.  He uses personally Sunpower Maxeon 6 AC PV cells with the Enphase iQ7A microinverters and recommended these for my moderately treed installation site.  The concept of AC from the roof rather than DC and microinverters to mitigate voltage drop for intermittent shading was appealing. Both product and workmanship warranty 25y and suitable for salt water environment.  Sure other systems were quoted and cheaper but the quality remains when price is forgotten.  Remember - you buy cheap you pay twice!Installers Travis and Ben were punctual, professional, cheerful and proficient.  Very happy to have used EVO Procam and grateful for the advice from Finn Peacock from SolarQuotes.  Now hanging out for the Enphase bidirectional EV charger, a potential game changer I suspect.

Cam was by far the most knowledgeable person to provide a quote and was not at all "salesy". Listened carefully to my requirements and clearly explained why the setup he recommended would be the best overall result, this was not the cheapest system I was offered but provided what I needed.Cam and his team were incredibly responsive and provided clear and regular communication throughout the entire process. Even when the installation team commenced work Cam was still in regular contact.The installation team were incredibly professional even under very trying conditions and involved us in the installation process so we could have input when unexpected little complications arose.Could not be happier with the service from Evo Solar....would encourage anyone to use them.

The sales/quoting process was thorough and very explanatory, with out being overly complicated or overly technicalThe installation crew were polite and tidy in the way they went about the installation.The crew missed their arrival time by only 30 minutes, but this was understandable due the the inclement weather. There was a real possibility the installation would not go ahead on the day agreed

The quote process was prompt and personalised to our needs.Upon acceptance the battery installation was expediently organised and completed within 4 days.The electrician was experienced and carried out the task in a professional, safe and efficient manner.The work site was thoroughly cleaned after completion and a safety inspection requested.The team at EvoSolar were a pleasure to deal with and I would recommend their service to anyone seeking a solar and/or battery back up system.

Excellent service, very prompt replies to all questions and requests for various quotes with different variations of panel size/configuration to determine the most suitable system.Installation was booked for the first available free dates and carried out very professionally and quickly over a day and a half.The system has been in place for a little over 2 weeks, so a bit too early to tell how well everything works in a range of conditions, but so far so good and can't fault at all.Thoroughly recommend Evo Solar.

The quote provided 4 options and the sales person was clearly enthusiastic and knowledgeable about all things solar. The installation team were punctual, tidy, polite and did a first class job. The admin side of the project was handled by their office team who also did a great job.
Easy to deal with, fully explained, design proposal and quote supplied in short turnaround.

The whole process went really smoothly, Cam wasn't pushy or salesy and he strikes me as a smart bloke who knows his trade. The system is up and running perfectly and Cam helped fix a glitch with the inverter phone app in no time.

Cam from EvoSolar was incredibly helpful and patient as he worked with me to design a system that fit my constraints. He always had time for my many questions, and probably prepared a half-dozen quotes before I was ready to sign.He made sure to send a larger team, to get the system installed in one day. They showed up right on time, did an excellent job, and always checked with me before drilling any holes or running any cables. The team was friendly, install was finished on time, and they tidied after themselves.I got a call a few days later from Evo Solar to check I was happy with everything, and to explain what the next steps would be.Overall, I am very satisfied and I would unreservedly recommend Evo Solar.

Quoting process was done online (other companies who quoted came out to site), no site inspection undertaken. The site inspection at quoting stage probably would have made it easier for the installers as they came out the day before to set up safety equipment and found that we had a few vents for ventilation fans on the roof which needed to be moved to fit the panels in. Was really happy that Travis worked a way around it as he didn't want the panels to be installed and not look good.Cam and the team were very helpful and really easy to deal with.

Cam was amazing! Knows all you need to know about solar/batteries etc. Polite, on time, tidy, very responsive and answered our many questions! We couldn’t ask for a better person to have worked with! Highly recommend to anyone contemplating Solar, batteries or wall box chargers. We will be using again in the future for a battery install!
Smooth streamline process from start to finish with clear quote comparisons and grid connection. A pleasure to deal with.

After having asked for several quote's for a solar installation I was less than impressed with the response received. I understand we live in an electronic age but I still like to think that my business and need's are heard and met, and not solely conducted over the internet.Evosolar listened to what I, through research, considered I might need, gave myself two quotes and offered to visit my house for a consultation, which none of the other quotes where interested in doing.The chosen system was of a more expensive system from a reputable manufacturer. Evosolar arrived on time, on a day that was very windy and at times very wet, I thought that there was no way that the installation would take place, but it did. It took longer of course, but the installers persisted and finished the project as promised.On the day a different spread of panel's was suggested for my roof, I was expecting the panel's to be mainly on the north facing aspect, but the suggested placement made more sense when explained to me and I'm very happy with the installation.The Installer's where punctual, polite and efficient, left no rubbish, did an excellent job especially given it was such a foul day with the weather.'If you are in the market for a solar system and live around the Geelong area I recommend Cam at Evosolar.
Extremely efficient company. Advice from Cameron was the reason for selecting this firm.

The whole process from contacting Evo Solar, discussing options, receiving detailed quotes for several options, planning and installation was a very positive experience. Cam from Evo Solar is very professional and helpful. He was guiding us through the whole process and took the time to answer any question we had along the way. The installation was on time and the workmanship of the team was excellent. Evo Solar also took care of commissioning and connecting the system.Dealing with anyone of their team was a pleasure.If you want a quality solar system at a fair price and the absolute best customer service, it is hard to go past Evo Solar -10 out of 10.

Cam has extensive knowledge about the products he sells. He is clearly passionate about solar and energy efficiency too. Cam completed a site inspection then provided several quotes to try suit our household needs and budget.The team that completed the install were on time, friendly and communicated well. The weather didn't make the install easy but the guys got the job done.Our home is all electric, so we are looking forward to the difference solar makes on our home thanks to the team at Evo Solar!
The sales process was informative and smoothThe install was neat and tidy with informative and personable installers.Everything was set up for us to begin storing energy, by the team

From the moment I contacted Evo Solar, to the installation of our 10kw system, the process has been seamless. The quote was supplied quickly and was extremely comprehensive. All of our questions were answered promptly and comprehensively. Communication was excellent, keeping us informed as to the installation and documentation that we needed to complete. On the day of installation, Evo Solar turned up at the pre arranged time and worked throughout the day to ensure all the work was completed. The installers were polite and extremely helpful, ensuring all rubbish etc was removed from site. Customer service was exemplary and they are assisting with grid connection.

Evo Solar was awesome to deal with and was quickly onto my online enquiry, with multiple quotes for different options emailed through and with follow up phone calls and a site visit.Evo Solar pre-wired up some conduits prior to the install of the solar system. The actual install of the system was completed over two days which consisted of 25 panels some on tilts, inverter and Tesla battery.If you need a solar system, don't hesitate to contact the team at Evo Solar.

Cam from Evo Solar answered all my questions and made the entire process very easy.Evo solar worked with me and were able to cater to my requests to fit in with a new house build.All parts of the installation and grid connection went very well, it was all sorted by Evo.I would definitely recommend Evo for anyone thinking of adding a solar system to their house.

Evo Solar were great to deal with at all stages - helpful, open and honest. Initial discussions and the quote (not the cheapest or the dearest) instilled confidence that they were experts in the field and provided value for money. The installation was smooth, and the team friendly and efficient. All is go now, and we are very happy with our experience. Thanks!

Can and the Evo Solar team were great to work with throughout the process. Cam provided great advice in choosing the system and worked with us to fine tune it. The installation team were great and worked quick and efficiently and very nice to deal with during the day. They even got us done ahead of schedule. Would definitely recommend Evo Solar to others.

From the quote to the installation of extra solar panels we were very impressed with the service provided. Evo Solar were punctual - arriving on time; very professional with the installation of panels with little disruption to our day and left the site clean and tidy. Very informative about managing the system.
It was very pleasant to work with the team from quote to installation. They were punctual and did a nice tidy job. I would recommend them highly.

Sales personnel were patient, took the time and trouble to carefully understand my requirements and explain everything to me.The installation was on time and I was kept informed throughout the process.Evo have handled the entire process from start to finish just as I requested, they kept all of their promises and made me a very happy and satisfied customer.
Cam was very informative, did exactly what he said he would, and the installation process was terrific, with friendly staff.

Solar Quote was obtained shortly after contact and discussing options.  They checked back to see if I had any queries.  The quote was very detailed including where the panels would go and they gave 3 different options which included estimates on saving based on my energy bills I had provided.Once quote was accepted they schedule in a date for installation.Installers turned up on the morning of the date and explained the process and that there would be a truck - arriving - if it was ok to park in the drive and did I need to get my car out- how polite - was impressed.The workmen were all very polite and left the property in good condition - even removing an old hot water system I had for free :)When work was complete, they showed me the system and advised that they would need to turn it off until it was inspected but that they had scheduled it in and would occur in 3 days time.Inspector came and everything was good so turned it on.I had old solar panels that the inverter failed on - it was nearly 12 years old and it seemed to be a lot of hassle - this was just seamless and I highly recommend them.

Had a great experienc with Evo Solar.Cam provided very helpful technical insights /advice for my consideration, which helped select a battery to meet my specific requirements when extending my solar array and installing a battery in May. I chose a Tesla Powerwall 2The quoting process was very straight forward and quick.Scheduling for the installation was within a few weeks.The installation team arrived when they said they would, completed the work promptly, and were a pleasure to deal with. The installation is very tidy and the team left the garage & surrounds spotless.Grid connection was done by Evo Solar, and the Electrical Safety review was completed within two days.Thanks Team!
Can’t fault these guys.From the initial system design and quote, through to install. Every step of the way has been simple, stress free and transparent.Communication has been excellent and prompt.

A possible complex and confusing process of selecting the right panels and inverter was made easier by Cam through his knowledge, experience and honest approach. The double storey installation was completed by an excellent team who were polite, tidy and punctual. They also  employed stringent safety procedures. The application for the solar rebates was made easy by the documentation provided. We received excellent customer service  beginning with the quoting  through to the stage of grid connection. We also received detailed information about the system and how to use the phone app to monitor the energy produced, used or sent back to the grid.

I can't fault EvoSolar on their sales/quoting process. Having done some research on the solarquotes.com site we had lots of questions as to different system options - size of inverter compared to capacity of panels, best location for panels, best location for inverter etc. Cam was very patient in answering our many questions and helped us to understand the process, costing and the best system to suit our needs.The team that installed the system were polite, tidy and punctual. We're really happy with our system and the service we received from EvoSolar and would happily recommend them to others looking for a quality system.

The guys at Evo were super helpful and the install was 10/10. I have a tricky roof and I am really happy with my output, especially given that it's mid winter. Testament to the clever work from Cam & the team - thanks!
Thank you so much for all your help just still need my inverter to connect to the internet.

Cam and the team were extremely pleasant to deal with. Nothing but positive experiences with them. Quick turnaround from order to installation. Very knowledgeable and friendly.Wouldn't hesitate to recommend and use their services again.

From the start Cam was very approachable and answered any questions we had.Installation wise everything was done on time and punctuality was spot on. we had some changes as my daughter was having a full system installed and we moved to a different day to help weather wise which fully arranged with Cam. Everything was left as it was once the job was done with no cleaning up requiredWe were in constant contact with Ros in admin for service dates and with Cam on the day to set up the Tesla app on my phone as I am not good in that way and Cam made it easy

Cam from Evo Solar was exceptionally proactive with his response to the project brief and came up with some good options outside of the specifications to win the competitive tender from 2 other tier 1 companies.Despite the challenges of bad weather and a difficult cable run, the team cheerfully and professionally got on with the job and delivered a very good outcome, technically and aesthetically.The Evo team managed everything for us in terms of grid connection, certificates etc.Very happy with the the whole process.

I recently had the pleasure of working with Cam and his team at a solar company, and I have nothing but positive things to say about my experience. From start to finish, they were easy to deal with and made the process of installing solar panels on my home a breeze.What impressed me the most was the quality of the system they designed for me. It's clear that they're experts in their field, and they were able to create a custom solution that met all of my needs at a reasonable price point. I feel confident that I made the right choice in choosing this company, and I would highly recommend them to anyone looking to make the switch to solar power.

Cameron and his team have been easy to deal with, very professional, great communicators, and the plan was delivered on time, on budget and clean.   The system performance has been all we desired.  Highly recommended if you are thinking of a solar/battery/charger installation crew.
Really happy with Cam and the team. Chose them because they were a fraction cheaper (same products) and could install faster than another comparable installer.

Received a referral to Evo Solar by SQ's. Quickly impressed by owner Cam's friendly nature and honest advice. Cam was attentive and engaging.  Received a professional quote. Cam visited a few days later to provide on site assessment.Installation went really well, bar the poor weather. Communication was clear and guys were punctual. Guys were really friendly and felt comfortable with them in and out of the house. Lovely fellah. Lead installer Travis was very knowledgeable.  Very neat install. Left the place clean and tidy.Systems working really well. Will happily use Evo for future upgrades including heat pump installation and splits.

Engaging Evo was the simple part. They have a polite group of installers who are very efficient. What made it easy for us was Evo organised everything after that. There are multiple steps involved including a contract to supply to Poweror.  Having Evo explain and guide us on each step certainly avoided any hiccups.  The panels on the shed roof and the two inverters on the wall have been fitted precisely and do look stylish.You may say its only a shed, however style is attention to detail and Evo understand that.Cheers

The entire process with Cam and the team at EvoSolar was awesome.  SolarQuotes shot me off to 3 different installers which I assume were all in my area.  Cam was the only one that came straight out to site to talk me through it, educate me on different systems etc.  Also super patient as I went backwards and forwards looking at all the various options an alternatives...All the other installers couldnt' come near this kind of service!Installation was booked in when they said it would be and the team turned up and did an awesome job.Hands down the easist knowledge bunch of guys to work with, haven't used any Grid power since its been installed!
The guys were great to deal to with, they did a good neat installation job.  Would be happy to use them again for any future additions.

System design and consulting was great and took our needs and budget into account.  Great communication from the team through the whole process.Install looks great.  We are very happy with all their hard work.

EvoSolar were prompt with their quotes, during a time when installers were taking weeks to get back to me. Cameron was happy to issue multiple quotes for me to compare, and we spoke on the phone a couple of times.The installation was very smooth, even to the point of Cameron helping me source some second hand roof tiles to replace broken roof tiles.The entire team was professional, and I can't think of anything negative.

Great from start to finish. quote superior to others received. the instal from very professional from staff and iteraction with myself and family.just waiting for final connection to benefit from their efforts. would recomend EVO.

Extremely knowledgeable, patient and happy to answer all of my questions ( and I had many) Polite neat and tidy, the install went well, they delivered exactly what was discussed. Very pleased with the outcome.

Highly recommended.Sales and quoting worked with what the house could do and my budget by providing several solutions and they didn't hassle me thoughout my decision making.EVO don't subcontract the installation work, who you speak to is who will turn up on the day. Everyone was happy, qualified and polite. I was given a run-down of the 3-phase inverter  and no mess was left behind.Applications, certificates and grid connections were organised on my behalf therefore, everything was taken care of.Bring on the sunshine.

Cam was very considered in his approach to the quoting process.  He made what is a difficult process to undertake quite clear and was more than happy to field factual questions about the systems being quoted on (both by him and by others without denigrating competitors offerings)Installation service was prompt and professional and delivered exactly what was promised and efficiently.Very happy with Evo's service and product

After a previous bad experience with Arkana Energy, Cam at Evo Solar got the job done for a fair price at very short notice. He and the team are very efficient and accommodating. His communication pre, during, and post-installation was exceptional. One of the nicest and most trustworthy people I have dealt with.

Evo Solar Geelong provided 4 different quotes to ensure that I was getting what I wanted. They were also the first company to get back to me with quotes.Not only were the installation crew polite, tidy and punctual, they also kept an eye out for my missing cat.It has been a pleasure to interact all of the team at Evo Solar Geelong.

Choosing a solar installer can be quite difficult, particularly with the exhaustive array of products available.We found Evo Solar to be very patient and attentive to all our queries and feel totally confident that we have made the right choice with Evo Solar. Thanks Cam.

The entire process with Cam and Ros was simple and easy to understand. Communication was perfect and installation went without a hitch.Evo Solar is made up of really good people and a pleasure to work with. Installation is clean and looks fantastic.

Cam was great to deal with. Provided timely answers to all questions and know how to best design a system for a flat roof with an existing Fronius inverter (master/slave) - rather then mixing inverter types.Installation was quick and on time by Patrick.Would recommend to anyone looking for a quality install.FYI - Getting a second inverter means you will need another Harvi monitor for a MyZappi car charger for the charger to work correctly. Make sure you have room for all the CT's in the box. You can never have enough room.

Fantastic work from start to finish from the team at Evosolar. Cameron was very professional, approachable and helpful from our first phone call, answering all our questions, to receiving our quote right through to installation. The team were punctual, efficient & polite.We’re really happy with our solar system & would highly recommend Evosolar

Sales/quoting experience was very good.Installation process, despite some significant hurdles at our place went very well, quick, efficient, certainly polite and easy to communicate with.Customer service was very good.

Evo Solar was one of 3 recommendations we were given when first looking to instal our system. It was Cameron’s no fuss and totally educated support that enticed us to choose them to install our solar system. They turned up exactly when they said they would , installed within the day and supplied top notch after installation information and support . Highly recommend them to anyone looking for a solar system installation!
Cam was terrific, explained thoroughly the quality of the system, provided quoted quickly and with detail, arrived on the date scheduled and executed the job really nicely.

Being new to Solar I had no idea what to look for. Cameron at Evo Solar was fantastic. Answered all my questions and explained in a way simple enough for me to understand!He installed a system suitable for our needs now and into the future. Would highly recommend
